app_context.design_philosophy: Vibrant, unique, and highly energetic to stand out in the Venezuelan market. Completely avoids the standard colors used by competitors like Ridery (Yellow/Black), Yummy (Red), and inDrive (Green). Focuses on high-contrast neon accents on a deep dark void base.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or generic system fonts for headings.
Use Outfit for all headings (H1-H4) and numerical displays.
Use DM Sans for body text, chat messages, and long descriptions.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospace font for Pago Movil reference numbers and IDs.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg text-center flex items-center justify-center neon_primary transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-secondary text-secondary rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-bold text-lg text-center flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-text_secondary rounded-full py-3 px-4 font-medium text-center flex items-center justify-center active:bg-background_elevated

inputs.default: bg-background_elevated text-white rounded-2xl p-4 text-base placeholder:text-text_secondary border border-transparent focus:border-secondary focus:neon_secondary transition-all outline-none
inputs.search_destination: bg-background_surface text-white rounded-2xl p-4 text-lg border border-border_subtle shadow-lg flex items-center gap-3

bottom_sheet.handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-border_subtle rounded-full mx-auto my-3

wallet_card.wrapper: bg-gradient-to-br from-background_elevated to-background_base border border-secondary/30 rounded-3xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden neon_secondary

map_pins.user_location: bg-secondary rounded-full w-6 h-6 border-4 border-background_base neon_secondary
map_pins.driver_car: bg-primary rounded-full w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-background_base neon_primary
map_pins.destination: bg-white text-background_base rounded-full w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center font-bold

onboarding.layout: Full screen background image with dark gradient overlay (bg-black/70). Logo at top, Role selector (Pasajero / Conductor) in center, Auth buttons at bottom.

passenger_home.layout: Full screen map. Floating search bar at top. Floating recent destinations. Bottom Sheet for ride configuration.

ride_confirmation.layout: Bottom sheet active. Shows map route. Displays estimated price (Bs/USD) in massive secondary color text. Driver details and car info.

wallet_pago_movil.layout: Wallet tab. Top section shows neon wallet card. Bottom section shows 'Recargar'. Recargar flow opens a modal with Bank, ID (Cedula), Phone, Reference Input, and Amount.

driver_home.layout: Map view. Large 'Conectarse' / 'Go Online' floating button. When active, incoming ride request pops up as an elevated modal with countdown.

admin_dashboard.layout: List layout (no map needed). Tabs for 'Recargas Pendientes', 'Usuarios', 'Viajes Activos'. Details view for manual Pago Movil verification.

motion_and_interactions.map: Smooth camera flying animation when searching destination. Pulse animation on user location pin.
motion_and_interactions.toasts: Slide in from top, neon borders depending on success/error.

media_and_assets.icons: Use lucide-react-native or @expo/vector-icons (Feather/Ionicons). Stick to minimalist line icons.

image_urls.description: Aerial view of Caracas cityscape at dusk to be used with a heavy dark overlay for the login screen.
Neon projection on dark background, use this color dynamic (Cyan/Magenta) for map routing lines.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This is an Expo/React Native app using .js files. Do not use pure HTML tags like <div> or <span>. Use <View>, <Text>, <TouchableOpacity>.
Use NativeWind for Tailwind styling if configured, or map these tailwind classes to StyleSheet.
All interactive elements MUST have the specified 'data-testid' mapped to the 'testID' prop in React Native.
Avoid using Shadcn Web components. Use React Native primitives or Expo libraries (@gorhom/bottom-sheet for sheets, react-native-maps for maps).
Implement the dark map style using react-native-maps customMapStyle prop, removing default POIs and coloring roads #1F2133 and water #0B0C10.
For the Pago Movil flow, ensure the inputs clearly indicate Venezuelan format (e.g., V- / J- prefix for ID, 0414/0424 for phone).
Keep the aesthetic purely Dark Mode with Neon accents (Magenta #FF007F and Cyan #00E5FF). Do not introduce white backgrounds for surfaces.
